title: Uzumaki: Spiral into Horror
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-schooler Kirie Goshima and her boyfriend Shuichi Saito live in Kurouzu-cho, a small town gripped by a curse of spirals. The curse twists residents' bodies and minds and reshapes the town itself, leading to the discovery of an ancient spiral city beneath it.
life_message: Holds up no clear ideal; it shows people holding on to love and loyalty while overwhelmed by forces they cannot understand.

delivery.evidence: Thompson (Wikipedia reception): dreamlike logic and nihilism, a fatalistic way of seeing the world; no stated message.
delivery.note: Its fatalistic outlook is conveyed through horror imagery rather than argument.

winners_losers: No one truly wins; the spiral curse consumes the town. Sympathy goes to Kirie and Shuichi as they endure together.
